extension.summary: Cast YouTube from your phone to Kodi, played through yt-dlp
Przesyłaj YouTube z telefonu do Kodi, odtwarzane przez yt-dlp
extension.description: Kodi shows up as a TV in the YouTube app: pick it from the cast menu, or link it once with a TV code. Every video is resolved by yt-dlp, which the add-on keeps current by itself, and played by InputStream Adaptive from YouTube's HLS manifest -- streamed, with seeking and quality switching, nothing downloaded first. No other add-on is needed for casting. An optional web interface plays any link yt-dlp supports -- YouTube, Dailymotion, Facebook, archive.org and many more, whole playlists as a queue -- shows what is playing with a seek bar, and the add-on's log.

Kodi pojawia się jako telewizor w aplikacji YouTube: wybierz go w menu przesyłania albo połącz raz kodem TV. Każdy film rozwiązuje yt-dlp, który dodatek sam aktualizuje, a odtwarza InputStream Adaptive z manifestu HLS YouTube -- strumieniowo, z przewijaniem i zmianą jakości, bez wcześniejszego pobierania. Do przesyłania nie jest potrzebny żaden inny dodatek. Opcjonalny interfejs WWW odtwarza dowolny link obsługiwany przez yt-dlp -- YouTube, Dailymotion, Facebook, archive.org i wiele innych, całe playlisty jako kolejkę -- pokazuje, co gra, z suwakiem przewijania, oraz log wtyczki.
extension.news: v2.3.0 - yt-dlp is compiled once per version, in the background; playback no longer compiles it every time (much faster starts on ARM boxes) - Check for updates now shows the version in use and the newest one, offers Update and shows the progress until the new version is ready - With automatic updates switched off, yt-dlp changes only through Check for updates now v2.2.1 - Fixed: Kodi crashed on the second playback. Kodi 21's Python (3.11) decodes \N{} escapes through a process-wide pointer that a finished plugin call leaves dangling; yt-dlp's sources are now rewritten without \N{} before anything compiles them v2.2.0 - Web interface (off by default, optional PIN): play or queue any yt-dlp link, seek, pause, stop, read the log - Other sites: DASH manifests, single files with unknown codecs (Facebook, archive.org), audio-only sites, headers and cookies - Playlist links become a queue in Kodi's video playlist; links with ?t= start there - Manifest rewriting is YouTube-only; other sites play their manifest as published v2.1.0 - Diagnostics tab (Expert settings level): one switch per area, all off by default - Settings - yt-dlp shows the version in use and how the last update check went - Without diagnostics only one summary line per playback, warnings and errors are logged v2.0.0 - Receives casts from the YouTube app itself: TubeCast is no longer needed - A phone linked with a TV code stays linked across restarts - Renamed to "yt-dlp Cast"
